handoff.note: The slow integrator runs, as on a straight walk, until the heading command moves faster than 2 deg/s. It stays frozen while that move continues or the heading error is still above 6 deg, then returns. The stance proportional and one-sided feedforward run only in that frozen window. Hip sign is unchanged from cfg_b.

restart.later_cycle_rises_on: next double-support edge at or after the requested time

commands.turn_180_note: 6 deg/s is a different command from the cfg_b 10 deg/s half-turn. The body rate measured on those 10 deg/s misses was about 7 deg/s, so the lag grew for the whole slew. The 4 s after t1 is the same budget cfg_b used, not an extension.

note: Separate from cfg_b. cfg_b scores and hash stay. Stop and stride x0.7 do not set a heading schedule, so this file does not retune them.
